Assignment Title: Practice 1 — Laboratory equipment register (user-defined objects)

Assignment Question:
Practice 1 — Laboratory equipment register (user-defined objects)
Problem
A laboratory issues equipment to students and records every issue as an item with a code and a name. If the same item code is issued more than once by mistake, only the first entry is kept. A second list records the items returned at the end of the session. Print how many items are still pending and list them in the order they were issued. An item is identified by its code alone.
Constraints
–   1 ≤ M ≤ 1000 (issued entries), 0 ≤ K ≤ M (returned entries)
–   Item code and item name: single words, up to 15 characters each
–   Two items are the same if and only if their codes are equal
–   A returned code that was never issued is simply ignored
–   The pending items must appear in issue order
Input format
–   Line 1: M
–   Next M lines: item code and item name (issued)
–   Next line: K
–   Next K lines: item code and item name (returned)
Output format
–   Line 1: Pending: k
–   Line 2: the pending items as code-name separated by a single space, or NONE if there are none

Practice 1 — Laboratory equipment register (user-defined objects)
Problem
A laboratory issues equipment to students and records every issue as an item with a code and a name. If the same item code is issued more than once by mistake, only the first entry is kept. A second list records the items returned at the end of the session. Print how many items are still pending and list them in the order they were issued. An item is identified by its code alone.
Constraints
–   1 ≤ M ≤ 1000 (issued entries), 0 ≤ K ≤ M (returned entries)
–   Item code and item name: single words, up to 15 characters each
–   Two items are the same if and only if their codes are equal
–   A returned code that was never issued is simply ignored
–   The pending items must appear in issue order
Input format
–   Line 1: M
–   Next M lines: item code and item name (issued)
–   Next line: K
–   Next K lines: item code and item name (returned)
Output format
–   Line 1: Pending: k
–   Line 2: the pending items as code-name separated by a single space, or NONE if there are none
Sample test case

	Input
	Expected Output
	
S1
	5
E10 Multimeter
E11 CRO
E10 Multimeter
E12 FunctionGen
E13 Breadboard
2
E11 CRO
E13 Breadboard
	Pending: 2
E10-Multimeter E12-FunctionGen
